messages:
oliver: Heads up  we had another support ticket where a projectless API key hopped into a project rate band for ~30s and triggered quota alerts/billing noise. Want to propose a Billing Grace Window to reduce flip-flop.

mira: yep saw the alert. Support wants clearer lineage in the console when ownership moves.

kevin: quick sketch: separate "serving affinity" (who gets latency/capacity) from "billing affinity" (who gets debited). By default, serving can be aggressive but billing only switches after a grace window.

oliver: exactly. serving_affinity_timeout could be short (5s) for perf; billing_grace_window default 60s. During grace, metrics show "billing.pending" state but requests routed according to serving_affinity.

mira: how do we surface pending billing state? Support needs to search and see which keys are in pending state across time.

kevin: telemetry plan: add trace tags routing.serving_owner, billing.state (pending|active|reverted), billing.pending_started_at, billing.decision_reason. Index a small sample in logs and add a compact timeline in key detail.

devon: also add a compact event stream in console for the key that shows serving changes vs billing commits. Eg: "T+0: served->project:foo, billing:pending" then at T+61 commit billing to project:foo.

oliver: billing accounting question: while billing is pending, do we count usage against org or project? My vote: charge org until commit; but keep shadow counters for project so we can reconcile if commit happens.

kevin: agree. Keep a shadow ledger for project during pending. If commit occurs, we move shadow entries into project ledger; if reverted, shadow is discarded and org retains charge. Ledger events must be exportable for billing reconciliation.

mira: safety: we need caps so a malicious actor can't keep small bursts to game us into committing lots of project quota. Add max_commits_per_hour per key and require higher sustain threshold after a demotion.

devon: add a cooldown: after billing revert, the key requires 2x sustain_window for next elevation and a longer grace_window. Also maintain consecutive_commit_count and cap to 3 per 24h.

kevin: rollout plan: feature-flagged behind billing-affinity-grace. Start with 2% keys for 72h, monitor billing deltas and support noise. Metrics: pending_count, commits_total, reverts_total, avg_pending_duration, per_key_commit_attempts.

mira: console UX: under Key > Overview show a small badge: Billing: org (active) or Billing: project:foo (pending->active). Hover gives a concise explanation and a link to the transaction timeline. Also allow admins to pin billing_target for a TTL.

oliver: API: PUT /v1/keys/:id/billing_policy {mode: "auto"|"pin_org"|"pin_project", ttl_sec?} Response returns previous policy. Audit-log mandatory and rate-limited.

kevin: include a manual commit endpoint for emergencies: POST /v1/keys/:id/force_commit {target: "project:foo", reason}. Admin-only, requires justification field, and creates an audit entry.

devon: telemetry detail: store decision_reason values: sustained, manual, anomaly, override. Keep them searchable as plain text in logs.

mira: we should also ensure the billing export includes two event types: 1) provisional_shadow rows, 2) commit rows that reconcile to project. Downstream billing transforms can then validate.

oliver: testing: synthetic workload generator to run 2k RPS bursts of 45s, 15s, 90s across canary keys. Verify pending->commit behavior and no false commits on short bursts.

ops-bot: Feature flag billing-affinity-grace enabled in staging at 1720023478 :white_check_mark:

kevin: deployed to staging. ran quick synthetic. observed 40s bursts stayed in pending and did not commit. 95s bursts committed as expected. Found minor drift in pending timer rounding; will patch.

devon: please add an analytics job to compute per-key commit frequency and mean pending duration over 7d so defaults can be tuned.

oliver: will add PLAT ticket and RFC. plz include runbook for rollback and billing reconciliation steps.

ops-bot: Created PLAT-8077: "Billing Grace Window + serving/billing affinity split RFC" assigned to oliver (https://tracker/redwood/PLAT-8077)

mira: thanks all. This should reduce alert noise and make support's life easier. :slightly_smiling_face:

kevin: will follow up with a concise RFC section on quota accounting and ledger migration notes.
